cc:Work.dc:title: Thirteen ports take half of all large-ship port visits; the busiest 25 take 74%
cc:Work.dc:description: Horizontal bar chart of the 25 busiest deep-draft ports by share of large-ship port visits, colored by coast, with the running total beside each bar; the running total passes 50% at the 13th port.
